scientific_checks.feature_timing_integrity: Strictly restricts input features to pre-interaction and trial-onset variables (stimulus type, reaction time to first touch). Post-trial variables such as total game completion time or overall session score are prohibited to prevent leakage.
scientific_checks.participant_level_grouping: Enforces GroupKFold grouped by participant_id (N=20 older adults, 436 game rounds) so no subject's individual motor profile appears simultaneously in training and validation folds.
